reviews.title: DO NOT BUY THEIR LIGHTSTRIPS
reviews.text:
I have four Feit lightstrips installed along the tops of my classroom walls, near a very high ceiling.  They worked fine with my iPhone 14.  Since switching to an iPhone 17 Pro Max, the app will no longer connect to them.  Now all four are essentially useless.

Upgrading my phone should not make lighting I already bought and installed unusable.  These strips are difficult to reach, so taking them down or replacing them would be a major hassle.  I put time and money into making my classroom a better space for my students, and now I am stuck with lights I cannot control because the app fails at its most basic function.

There is nothing “smart” about lighting that becomes useless after a phone upgrade.  This has been an infuriating waste of time and money.  Feit, fix your app.  I bought these lights expecting to use them beyond the life of one phone.

reviews.title: Do not recommend

It has glitched out and not recorded critical information on my property more than a few times now. I thought it was maybe a fluke faulty camera so I bought one more this time a pan tilt zoom indoor and placed it in my climate controlled garage. I have the same issues, unable to establish connection playback errors, the app crashes when searching through recorded events if you skip ahead more than 2 times in a video if freezes and app shuts down. It stops recording randomly during motion events. I do not recommend this. My garage was broken into and the footage recorded instead of motion tracking like it was supposed to was just the camera just zoomed into the ceiling and I could only listen to people stealing all my stuff and not see them or provide anything of value for video to the police because both of the cameras failed when they were both aimed in the right spot nothing but let down. My cameras were calibrated properly and when sound detection alerted me I instantly opened app like 7 times before it worked and the view my camera showed was all white from my ceiling but I could hear the thieves. About 3 hours prior to break in the camera got a mind of its own and tiled straight up. Very very mad I am and regret buying them. False peace of mind

Most of the time, they will take them back even if you bought it years ago. If enough people do this, they’ll quit taking products from FEIT. There are plenty of other good options for reasonably priced outdoor cameras with SD cards that doesn’t play these stupid games. REALLY BAD MOVE FEIT! DID YOU THINK WE WOULD NOT NOTICE? Beware! They may be seeking to try to force us to go to iCloud in the near future if we still want to review our recordings on these cameras that we already installed. Too many other choices for the same price or less with SD cards. Many of us want our privacy and do not want the risk of cloud servers for security cameras!

reviews.text: All was working great with my light bulb. It paired easily and paired with Alexa, just as easily. then the power went out, came back on, and the bulb went into pairing mode. It has my 2.4 GHz connection is a 5.0 connection maybe that’s because it has 51 in the name of it? anyway, I can’t connect manually and when it says it needs to be a slow blink 2 to 4 seconds I found where it ended up showing me a one second blink in a graphic. So I turned the bulb on off on and off on off and got a fast blink. The words in the app said make it a slow blink and down below was a little checkbox to let them know when it was on a fast blink. So why would they say make it slow but let us know when it’s fast? So I sat and tried to pair with the slow blink as well as the fast blink and I am stuck. It will not pair. Why????

reviews.title: I used to love and recommend. No longer.
reviews.text: I rely on the schedule feature, especially during the winter and dark mornings. The erratic nature of the schedule availability has actually made me miss appointments because unfortunately, this THIS APP is not reliable. :/ Here are the main issues: 1. UPDATES: I must constantly re-add lights and with updates, lose my wake up lights (sometimes as I sleep). Recently, I spent 2 hours trying to add lights before I figured out I am REQUIRED to allow PRECISE LOCATION to add the lights. The “add light” kept failing despite meeting all criteria (correct wifi password, platform, proximity to phone, and use location). 2: POOR USER INSTRUCTIONS: Every update is another problem. This latest forced me to register, but didn’t specifically call out the new requirements. I have to troubleshoot forever, sifting through others’ comments to try new things because I’m not the only one having issues. PLEASE give customers an in-app summary of changes that might impact them. 3. WEAK WIFI READING: I have great wifi (per my laptop in same area), but the app frequently thinks I am not in wifi range. I used to continuously receive weak signal messages. That seems improved with precise location on, but this was a headache for 7 months. 4: COST: This product was not cheap, but used to be a reasonable investment. The features and functionality made it worthwhile as an additional wakeup support, and being able to adjust the amount of light when it came on and gradually increase was so helpful. THIS PRODU

reviews.title: Frustrating. Will Replace My Lights with Another Brand
reviews.text: I can create a schedule to turn on and off my exterior lights, but the specified color doesn’t work. The lights always turn on to white even though I have set them to purple (for Halloween), orange (for Thanksgiving). I tried everything to get the lights to turn on to the pre-set color.  I have pre-set the same color in each individual light as well as a group schedule. There is a default light setting for a grouping that initializes light color when powered on. I have tried all 3 options, and none of them result in the lights turning on to the pre-set color. The lights always turns on to white, then I have to manually change colors. I’m done wasting my time fiddling with the software. Throwing the lights in the trash and replacing with lights that have better software. I bought these through Costco at a decent price.  Unfortunately, I got what I paid for.
